metadata.database: A Deeper China | Hangzhou decision layer

HZM01.guest_need: A visitor wants West Lake as a slow landscape, not a lap around a postcard.
HZM01.hidden_need: Choose a short question and protect shade, seating and time.
HZM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One lake relationship is deeper than collecting every causeway, bridge and viewpoint.
HZM01.stop_condition: The visitor has understood one relationship between water, hills and city life.
HZM01.low_energy_branch: Use one accessible lake edge and a seated pause.
HZM01.rain_branch: Shorten the lake and move to a confirmed indoor/cultural layer.
HZM01.body_cost: Variable walking with heat, crowds and shade gaps.

HZM02.guest_need: A visitor wants tea as landscape, labour and taste—not just a purchase.
HZM02.hidden_need: Separate mountain walking, learning and buying intentions.
HZM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One tea question links landscape and labour better than a shop or ceremony promise.
HZM02.stop_condition: The visitor can explain one relationship between tea place, work and taste.
HZM02.low_energy_branch: Use a lower-load tea/cultural stop without forcing a hill route.
HZM02.body_cost: Moderate hills/heat and high expectation-management load.

HZM03.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide if Lingyin fits their body, beliefs and cultural interest.
HZM03.hidden_need: Avoid treating worship, Buddhist art and mountain atmosphere as interchangeable.
HZM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One sacred/mountain question is enough; adding more temples dilutes etiquette and attention.
HZM03.stop_condition: The visitor has a respectful, clear reason for being there.
HZM03.low_energy_branch: Choose the accessible confirmed layer and omit hills.
HZM03.rain_branch: Use only after entry, weather and surface checks.
HZM03.body_cost: Moderate walking, hills, crowds and etiquette load.

HZM04.guest_need: A visitor wants Hangzhou beyond scenery through Song memory and water-city urbanity.
HZM04.hidden_need: Choose history, commerce or canal life instead of another scenic loop.
HZM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One water-city/history layer explains Hangzhou’s urban culture better than more lake photos.
HZM04.stop_condition: The visitor can connect memory, water and current urban use.
HZM04.low_energy_branch: Choose one indoor/history anchor and one short public street.
HZM04.rain_branch: Use confirmed indoor history or covered water-city layer.
HZM04.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking with crowds and commercial noise.

HZM05.guest_need: A visitor needs a quieter or weather-resilient alternative to a crowded West Lake day.
HZM05.hidden_need: Protect the same landscape question with lower crowd/heat cost.
HZM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One wetland/recovery branch preserves landscape time without forcing the busiest lake route.
HZM05.stop_condition: The visitor has recovered and retained a nature question.
HZM05.low_energy_branch: Use the shortest confirmed public edge and seating.
HZM05.rain_branch: Primary recovery branch after opening and surface checks.
HZM05.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking, weather and transport sensitivity.

HZM06.guest_need: A repeat visitor wants contemporary Hangzhou and digital life rather than another scenic stop.
HZM06.hidden_need: Match the current programme to a real urban/technology question.
HZM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One present-day public-life layer adds a new question beyond lake/tea heritage.
HZM06.stop_condition: The visitor can identify one current city pattern and its human friction.
HZM06.low_energy_branch: Choose one confirmed public programme or design/tech layer.
HZM06.rain_branch: Indoor branch after programme and access checks.

HZM07.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide day trip, overnight or destination-level Hangzhou.
HZM07.hidden_need: Prevent West Lake/tea/religion from being squeezed into a same-day return.
HZM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A pacing decision protects the actual purpose of Hangzhou better than adding a checklist.
HZM07.stop_condition: The visitor has one anchor, travel time and overnight decision.
HZM07.low_energy_branch: Choose one anchor or stay overnight.
HZM07.rain_branch: Use current rail and indoor programme before changing the plan.
HZM07.body_cost: Rail, last-mile and crowd timing are the main costs.

HZM08.guest_need: A visitor needs the route to survive heat, rain, hills and crowds.
HZM08.hidden_need: Make mobility and seasonal friction primary design inputs.
HZM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A recovery/mobility layer prevents an attractive but unusable lake/tea plan.
HZM08.stop_condition: The visitor has a credible route with rest, transport and weather fallback.
HZM08.low_energy_branch: Keep one accessible anchor and a protected buffer.
HZM08.rain_branch: Primary weather branch; remove exposed hills and long lake loops.
HZM08.body_cost: Operational cost: heat, stairs, crowds, shade and last-mile transfers.
